layers.message: Add reminder service with manual tick endpoint

prompt.utterance: Explain how the five components depend on each other.

graderOnly: The five components are src/config.js, src/store.js, src/mailer.js, src/scheduler.js, and src/api.js; src/app.js is the composition root that wires them and is not one of the five.

Static imports among the five: src/mailer.js imports DEFAULT_FROM from src/config.js, and src/api.js imports parseDueAt from src/scheduler.js. src/config.js, src/store.js, and src/scheduler.js import none of the other components. src/app.js imports all five.

Runtime wiring in createApp (src/app.js): loadConfig(env) supplies config.from to createMailer, config.maxBatch to createScheduler, and config.intervalMs to scheduler.start; the store and the mailer are injected into createScheduler; the store and the scheduler are injected into createApi.
At run time the scheduler calls store.due, mailer.send, and store.markSent; the api calls store.list, store.add, parseDueAt, and scheduler.tick (POST /tick).

The api never receives or calls the mailer; it reaches the mailer only indirectly through scheduler.tick(). The store depends on no other component. Config is used only by app.js (wiring) and by mailer.js (the DEFAULT_FROM constant). Nothing calls back from the store or the mailer into the scheduler or the api.
The mailer's transport is a function injected by the caller of createApp (tests pass a fake); there is no real network transport in the repository.

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture with the default installed workflow state (no cycle); Navigator needs only project code. Layer 00-project (pre-install commit) is a small Node ES-module reminder service. README.md names the five components (config, store, mailer, scheduler, api) and says src/app.js wires them, so 'the five components' in the utterance resolves to real files. Relationships come from two sources: two static imports (mailer -> config for DEFAULT_FROM, api -> scheduler for parseDueAt) and constructor injection in src/app.js (config values into mailer and scheduler, store+mailer into scheduler, store+scheduler into api). The mix means a correct diagram must distinguish import edges from wiring edges and must not draw an api -> mailer call path. No code comment or name hints at the expected answer. Tests are node:test with explicit files and write no files.
